name: John Joseph Quinn
locations: Saint John the Evangelist Cemetery, Hydes, Baltimore County, Maryland
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 206242611 (Ann Jane Quinn Bradley, 1847–1912) and 22191188 (John Joseph Quinn, d. 15 Apr 1883, "25 Years, 2 months, 14 days")
FamilySearch, United States Census, 1870 (District 3, Harford County, Maryland; James Quin, 45, with Barney, 17, and John, 12, born Ireland, in the household of Joseph Harlan; ark 1:1:MN3F-2C8)
FamilySearch, United States Census, 1880 (Fallston, Harford County, Maryland; James Quin, 57, labourer on farm, with Sarah, 54, Joseph, 21, and Barney, 27; ark 1:1:MNQG-LPP)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Quinn Family Tree" (tree 11167102)
notes: Son of James and Sarah (Mooney) Quinn, born in Ireland in 1858 (his stone gives his age at death as 25 years, 2 months, 14 days, so about 1 Feb 1858); John, 12, with his father and brother in 1870, and Joseph, 21, at Fallston in 1880; died 15 Apr 1883 and buried at Hydes, "Native of County Antrim, Ireland".
